en: Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped city park with paths, lawns, and dense trees in the foreground. In the background stands a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings with classical façades. One central building has a tall domed tower topped by a cross or finial, flanked by similar residential or institutional blocks. The scene is photographed from an elevated position, as in a typical early postcard of a European city park.
